targetTexts.2: “Truly then you are the people with whom wisdom itself will die!
targetTexts.3: But I also have a mind; I am not inferior to you. Who does not know such things as these?
targetTexts.4: I am a laughingstock to my friends, though I called on God, and He answered. The righteous and upright man is a laughingstock.
targetTexts.5: The one at ease scorns misfortune as the fate of those whose feet are slipping.
targetTexts.6: The tents of robbers are safe, and those who provoke God are secure—those who carry their god in their hands.
targetTexts.7: But ask the animals, and they will instruct you; ask the birds of the air, and they will tell you.
targetTexts.8: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you; let the fish of the sea inform you.
targetTexts.9: Which of all these does not know that the hand of the LORD has done this?
targetTexts.10: The life of every living thing is in His hand, as well as the breath of all mankind.
targetTexts.11: Does not the ear test words as the tongue tastes its food?
targetTexts.12: Wisdom is found with the elderly, and understanding comes with long life.
targetTexts.13: Wisdom and strength belong to God; counsel and understanding are His.
targetTexts.14: What He tears down cannot be rebuilt; the man He imprisons cannot be released.
targetTexts.15: If He holds back the waters, they dry up, and if He releases them, they overwhelm the land.
targetTexts.16: True wisdom and power belong to Him. The deceived and the deceiver are His.
targetTexts.17: He leads counselors away barefoot and makes fools of judges.
targetTexts.18: He loosens the bonds placed by kings and fastens a belt around their waists.
targetTexts.19: He leads priests away barefoot and overthrows the established.
targetTexts.20: He deprives the trusted of speech and takes away the discernment of elders.
targetTexts.21: He pours out contempt on nobles and disarms the mighty.
targetTexts.22: He reveals the deep things of darkness and brings deep shadows into light.
targetTexts.23: He makes nations great and destroys them; He enlarges nations, then disperses them.
targetTexts.24: He deprives the earth’s leaders of reason and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.
targetTexts.25: They grope in the darkness without light; He makes them stagger like drunkards.
